verdict.rationale: Supabase documents its own Database Webhooks feature, which sends real-time data to another system whenever a table event occurs. That is a first-party, registrable event-subscription mechanism, but the evidence is a single line scoped to database table events. Realtime channels are client messaging, not outbound webhooks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTP endpoint registration and payload format, delivery guarantees/retries and signing, webhook coverage of non-database events (auth, storage, platform), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
